title: List[Int](range(start, end, step)) aborts when the range is not empty and start - end is ±2^63
compiler: prints `before`, then aborts: "ABORT: Mojo/stdlib/std/memory/alloc.mojo:1021:18: Layout: `length` must be >= 0". _StridedRange._signed_count computes abs(start - end), which wraps, and List's initializer from an iterable reserves the negative count. 1.2.0 aborts the same way, with "alloc.mojo:888:14: alloc: Layout.count() must be >= 0"
fixed: builds the range's list, `[-1, 9223372036854775806]`: every element lies between start and end, and only the reserved size overflows

confirmation.notes: provisional ruling, until the human has discussed it with Modular

nightly.result: aborts as above; the stdlib's TODO(MSTDL-3087) above _signed_count names the wrap
